about: OPPONENT SCALING CONFIG: the one place to tune how strong Infinite/Loop opponents are. Round = infinite match number (Infinite) or 8 x (loop - 1) + bracket slot (Loop). The game (src/Engine/OpponentScaling.cs) and the simulator (tools/sim.py) both read these rows. Classic mode keeps the game's own difficulty.

slot_classes.about: Bracket slot -> opponent class (also in teams.json slots).

opponent_techniques.about: Vanilla Techniques that may join an opponent's random perks alongside Overtime perks marked opponent_ok. Preflight rejects any that use the shared 'timer' field or player-only global state.

vanilla_rarity.about: Rarity of each vanilla Technique for scaling: a team's built-in perks also wait for their rarity's unlock round (rare_from / epic_from).
